paite: Huan ngai in, TOUPA thu in Judah gam a pan Bethel ah Pathian mipa khat ahong hi. Maitam chin ah gimlim hal ding in Jeroboam ana ding hi.

Ama'n TOUPA thu in maitam akikoukhum a, "Maitam aw, maitam, TOUPA'N hichi in achi: 'Ngai in, David inkuan ah tapa, amin Josiah ahong piang dia, ama'n na tung a gimlim halna mun sang a siampute na tung ah alan dia, na tung ah mihing guhte ahal ding, " achi hi.
Huai ni mah in chiamtehna apia hi. “Hiai TOUPA'N chiamtehna ding achih ahi. Ngai in, maitam ahong khangkham dia, atung a meivute ahong bo vek ding," achi hi.

Huan hichi ahong hi a, Pathian mipa in Bethel a maitam akikoukhum thu kumpipa'n azak in, Jeroboam in, "Man un," chi in maitam a pan akhut in asawk hi. Mat tum a asawkna khut azawta a, akhut akaikik nawn theita kei hi.
Pathian mipa in TOUPA thu chiamtehna dia agen bang in maitam leng akhangkham a, maitam a meivute leng abo vek uhi.

Kumpipa'n adawng a, Pathian mipa kiang ah, "Ka khut ahong dam nawn theihna ding in TOUPA na Pathian hehpihna ngen inla, hon thumsak in," achi hi. Pathian min TOUPA kiang ah angen a, kumpipa khut ahong dam nawn a, amalam a bangmah in ahong om nawnta hi.
Huchi in kumpipa'n Pathian mipa kiang ah, "Ka inn ah kei toh i pai dia hong kihihhalh tadih inla, huchi in kipahman ka hon pe ding," achi hi.
Pathian mipa in kumpipa kiang ah, "Na inn kimkhat zah hon pe ding himah lechin leng na kiang ah ka hong pai tuan kei ding, hiai ah tanghou ne in tui himhim leng ka dawn sam kei ding.
Tanghou va ne in tui himhim leng va dawn ke'nla, 'Na va hohna lampi ah leng kik nawn ke'n chi a TOUPA thu a sawl ka hi,' " achi hi.
Huchi in lampi dang ah apai a, Bethel a ahong kuanna lampi ah apaita kei hi.
Bethel ah zawlnei putek khat a-om hi. Atapate'n huai ni a Bethel a Pathian mipa thilhih tengteng ahilh vek uhi. Kumpipa kiang a athugente leng apa uh ahilh lai uhi.
heading: Bethel Ah Zawlnei Putek

paite: Apa un akiang uah, "Koi lampi atawn a?" achi hi. Atapate'n Judah gam a pan hong pai Pathian mipa pai nawnna lampi akawkmuh uhi.
Huchi in atapate kiang ah, "Sabiltung hon bawlsak dih uh," achi hi. Sabiltung abawlsak ua; atung ah atuang hi.
Pathian mipa adelhta a, tosaw sing nuai a tu in ava mu hi. Akiang ah, "Nang na hi maw Judah gam a pan hong pai Pathian mipa?" achi hi. Ama'n, "Hi e,” achi hi.
Huchi in ama'n akiang ah, "Ka inn ah kei toh hong pai inla; tanghou hong ne dih ve,” achi hi.
Ama'n, "Nang toh kik nawn thei ka hi kei, na kiang a hong thei leng ka hi sam kei. Hiai ah na kiang ah tanghou ne in tui himhim leng ka dawn sam kei ding.
Tanghou va ne in tui himhim leng va dawn ke'nla, na va hohna lampi ah leng kik nawn ke'n, chi a TOUPA thu a hilh lah ka hi ngal a,” achi hi.

Ama'n akiang ah, "Kei leng nangmah bang a zawlnei ka hi. Angel in TOUPA thu in, tanghoute ne a tuite dawn ding in na inn ah pikik nawn in, chi in ahon houpih hi," achi hi. Himahleh akiang ah zuau agen hi.
Huchi in akiang ah akik nawn a, a-inn ah tanghoute ne in tui adawnta hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, dohkan a-um lai un, apikik nawnpa zawlnei kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung hi.
Huchi in Judah gam a pan hong pai Pathian mipa kiang ah, TOUPA'N hichi in achi, "TOUPA thugen mang lou a, TOUPA na Pathian in thu ahon piak na zuih louh a,
hong kik nawn a, tanghou ne in tui leng dawn ke'n, ka chihna mun mahmah a tanghou ne a, tui na dawn ziak in na luang na pute han a koih ahi kei ding," chi in agenkheta hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, tanghou ne a, tui adawn zoh in, zawlnei pikik nawnpa'n sabiltung abawlsak hi.
Huchi in apaita a lamkal ah humpinelkai toh akituak ua, ana that hi. Aluang lampi ah akipai a, akiang ah sabiltung adingh a, humpinelkai leng siluang kiang ah adingh hi.
Ngai in, mi ava pai ua, lampi a siluang kipai leh siluang kiang a humpinelkai dingh amu ua; zawlnei putek tenna khua ah ava gen uhi.

Lamkal a pan va pikik nawnpa zawlnei in huai thu ana zaktak in, "Pathian mi, TOUPA thugen mang nuamloupa ei ve. Huchi in ToUPA'N akiang a agen, athu bangbang a TOUPA'N humpinelkai kiang a pia a, na ham a, na keilum ahita ve," achi hi.
Atapate kiang ah, "Sabiltung hon bawlsak dih uh," chi in agen a; abawlsak uhi.
Huchi in akuanta a, aluang lampi a kipai leh sabiltung leh humpinelkai a luang kiang a dingh ava mu hi. Humpinelkai in luang ana ne nai kei a, sabiltung leng ana ham kei hi.
Zawlnei in Pathian mipa luang adom a, sabiltung tung ah akoih a, akikpihta hi. Huchi in zawlnei putek tenna khua ah suun ding leh vui ding in alalut hi.
Aluang ama han ah asial a, "Ka unaupa khawk hi na mah e!" chi in asuun uhi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, avui khit nung in atapate kiang ah, "Ka sih chiang in Pathian mipa kivuina han ah hon vui sam un. Aguhte kiang ah ka guhte koih un.
Pathian thu a Bethel a maitam leh Samaria gam khopite a mun sangte inn tengteng akikoukhumna thu hong tung ngeingei ding ahi,” achi hi.
Huai thil zoh in Jeroboam in a omdan diklou atawpsan tuan kei hi. Miniampente lak a mun sang siampu dia abawl siampute a-omtheihna ding un adeihdeih ahihtuam hi.
heading: Jeroboam Khelhna

paite: Huai thil Jeroboam inkuan khelhna amau inn gamsaktu leh leitung maikaih a pan hihmangthangtu ahong hita hi.
